corrections_from_v1.status: code corrected to match the claim
corrections_from_v1.what_changed: The Hedge update is suppressed for every bar before the first tradeable bar -- learning begins when trading begins. hedge_rounds counts rounds actually played rather than bars elapsed, because the anytime rate sqrt(8 ln N / t) is derived for t = rounds played; indexing by absolute bar would start real learning at eta(201) instead of eta(1). No constant is introduced: WARMUP_BARS was already the max over expert warm-ups. Weights entering the first tradeable bar are now exactly uniform 1/N.
corrections_from_v1.what_was_wrong: target_positions masked the warm-up OUTPUT but run_mixer ran the full Hedge update across it. trend_signal_at returns 0.0 before its horizon, bitwise identical to cash's hard-coded 0.0, so the two weights moved in lockstep for all 200 warm-up bars and the trend expert carried cash's record for an opinion it never expressed. The weight vector entering the first tradeable bar was 0.4983 total-variation from uniform with always_long at exactly 0.000000, and eta had already decayed 3.3302 -> 0.2355 so a crushed expert could not recover. The uniform prior was true only at bar 0, which is never traded.

corrections_from_v1.claim_in_v1: The cash expert is the only element making the pool strictly richer than any constituent ... Any genuine improvement would have to come from there.
corrections_from_v1.status: claim withdrawn and replaced; the loss function is unchanged
corrections_from_v1.what_changed: The preregistered mechanism claim only. The 0/1 directional loss is the textbook Hedge loss the regret bound is stated for; replacing it with a magnitude-weighted loss would be a different algorithm needing its own derivation, and selecting that weighting after observing which behaves better on synthetic paths is the parameter-selection-after-viewing-results this project forbids.
corrections_from_v1.what_was_wrong: Under the 0/1 directional loss, log(w_cash / w_always_long) is a bar-COUNT race with no magnitude term, so cash gains weight only when down-bars outnumber up-bars. That is not the condition 'holding cash would have been better'. On a negatively skewed path -- frequent small gains, occasional large losses, the defining shape of crypto returns -- the two conditions come apart: a synthetic series with 567 up bars against 332 down bars and a buy-and-hold return of -82.5% drove cash to exactly 0.000000 while the mixture stayed long on 100% of tradeable bars. Two series sharing one sign path, one ending +5.9% and one ending -100%, produced final w_cash/w_always_long agreeing to fourteen significant figures.

That it is rejected. It is unevaluated, which is a different state and must not be relabelled.

That the two corrections below improve the candidate. MSF-1 restores the prior the record already claimed; MSF-2 withdraws a claim. Neither was chosen because it performed better, and neither has been measured against anything.

That this is the complete set of semantic defects. Nine of thirteen red-team agents died on an account spend limit before reporting, including every refutation agent; the adversarial-refutation stage has not run.
honest_prior_stated_before_any_result: WEAK, and for a structural reason. Hedge-style mixtures carry a RELATIVE guarantee: bounded regret against the best single expert in hindsight. They do not manufacture edge. Three of the four experts are recorded in research/v2/negative_evidence_index.jsonl as research_stage_rejected, so if the pool is null the mixture's best realistic outcome is roughly as good as the least bad rejected expert, which qualifies under no honest criterion. The prior is now WEAKER than v1 stated. v1 named the cash expert as the one place a genuine improvement could come from; V2F-MSF-2 established that under a 0/1 directional loss cash gains weight only when down-bars outnumber up-bars, which is not the same as cash having been the better choice, and on a negatively skewed series the two come apart completely. The pool is therefore richer than any constituent only in a sense the loss function cannot reward on the return shape this candidate would be pointed at. No replacement mechanism is claimed. Recording this in advance is what stops a later reader from inventing a better story after the fact.
hypothesis: Reallocating weight between a fixed pool of experts from their realized past performance beats the buy-and-hold benchmark on a lawful forward partition, where each fixed allocation in that pool did not. This is a claim about the ADAPTATION, not about any expert.

no_fitted_constants.decision_rule: strictly more than half the weight -- this is what Weighted Majority IS, not a chosen threshold
no_fitted_constants.expert_parameters: frozen at their V2A pre-registered values; re-tuning would be new_parameter_selection
no_fitted_constants.initial_weights: uniform 1/N, the maximum-entropy prior, holding at the first TRADEABLE bar
no_fitted_constants.learning_rate: eta_t = sqrt(8 ln N / t), the standard anytime Hedge rate, derived from the regret bound, with t counting Hedge rounds actually played
no_fitted_constants.learning_start: the first tradeable bar; a bar in which an expert has no opinion is not a round
no_fitted_constants.loss: 0/1 directional, flat bar charges nobody; no clip, scale, or normalization constant

open_questions_not_answered_before_this_: Cost asymmetry: whether transaction costs are coherent with a loss that ignores them.
Degenerate cases: ties, zero returns, missing bars, all-equal and all-wrong expert pools.
An independent scalar reimplementation agreeing with the vectorized path.

Cash's flat vote caps mixture_weight at 1 - w_cash; of 200 GBM paths 1 never went long and 9 went long on under 5% of tradeable bars. Measured before the MSF-1 fix and therefore superseded; it must be re-measured before freeze.

supersedes.fingerprint_changed_because: learning_start entered fixed_parameters and learning_rate now names rounds played rather than bars elapsed. The identity of the algorithm changed, so its fingerprint had to; a supersession that left the fingerprint alone would be claiming the same algorithm.
supersedes.reason: Two inconsistencies between the v1 record and the code it described, found by the pre-freeze semantic red team and reproduced independently. Both are corrected here, before any evaluation. See docs/V2F_MIXER_PRE_FREEZE_SEMANTIC_FINDINGS.md.
